ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (a) the Services, including the Hosting Services and Support Services, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) for a period of 12 months following delivery, the Interface, all related software and all deliverables will conform to their documentation; (c) for a period of 90 days following performance, the Services will conform to their documentation; (d) the Interface and all related software will be free of malicious code; and (e) TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software, deliverable or Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so we have inserted our standard performance warranty: the Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, conformance to documentation for 12 months (software and deliverables) and 90 days (Services), no malicious code and compliance with laws, with a repair, replacement or refund remedy. If the periods are an issue we can discuss our fallback of 90 days for software and 30 days for Services with the same remedies.
proposal.summary: Insert a TrueLink performance and conformance warranty with repair, replacement and refund remedies.
